description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Layout_Horizontal', which manages a horizontal layout for graph elements by splitting the area into two parts side by side, either by percentage or absolute position. It depends on a parent layout class and is part of the Image_Graph package, specifically within the Layout subpackage.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Layout_Horizontal
classes.description: Layout class that arranges two graphical elements side by side horizontally with a specified split.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Layout_Horizontal
methods.description: Constructor initializes a horizontal layout with two parts and a split percentage or auto.

methods.name: _getAbsolute
methods.description: Calculates and returns the absolute position for the split, based on size of parts.

methods.name: _split
methods.description: Splits the layout into two parts according to the specified percentage or auto mode.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Finalizes the layout rendering process for both parts.
